prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity retro pixel-art NPC facial eye-animation atlas, portrait record 86.
Input image: the supplied eyes-reference-grid.png is the identity and geometry authority. It is a 2x2 grid of the same original upper portrait half, repeated and enlarged 8x.
Primary request: Edit the reference into one neutral eye atlas. Keep the same woman and exact face identity. The atlas has four equal cells in row-major order: open, half closed, fully closed, repeated open. Match the reference placement and proportions; each cell represents one native 64x35 upper half. Keep eye centers, spacing, gaze direction, iris width, pupil positions, glint positions, brow positions, skin shading and orbital crease shapes consistent across cells.
Eye geometry: preserve the original brown irises and olive-brown shadows. During half blink, lower lids vertically over the same stationary eyeballs; do not move highlights down, shrink or round the irises, shift pupils sideways, change gaze, or let lids cross the lower lid. Fully closed lids conceal iris and sclera completely. Keep both brows fixed in height and shape during all three phases. Repeated open should match open.
Style and palette: retain the original's low-resolution native pixel grid, muted warm tan skin, olive/brown eye shadows, brown irises, soft blended contrast and restrained shading. Preserve pixel clusters after downsampling; no smooth vector outlines, circles, added texture, bright white flashes, orange skin, dark black brow strokes or increased contrast.
Constraints: change only neutral eyelid/brow expression to relaxed neutral. Preserve face width, brows, forehead, hair and hood/hairline, nose bridge, cheeks and surrounding skin. No text, borders, extra panels, watermark, face resizing or altered crop.
